newsitem.title: USA: Chicago could be seen supporting second NFL team.
newsitem.headline: Chicago could be seen supporting second NFL team.

text.p: Chicago Mayor Richard Daley said Thursday the city could easily support two National Football League teams and he would like to see details of a business plan to bring another franchise as a tenant for a new domed stadium, the Chicago Tribune reported Friday.

A group of businessmen headed by longtime Democratic operative Tom Carey would like to lure the Arizona Cardinals back to the city where it had played decades ago, the Tribune said. Cardinals ownership called the suggestion "a fairy tale," however, the newspaper said.
Carey has based his plan on NFL realignment, a new television contract and the hope that a second team would make financing a $500 million stadium more palatable to politicians, the Tribune reported.
